# Vendors

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List vendors

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/vendors`

Retrieve a paginated list of vendors with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, country, state, title, company, industry, user, creator, addresses, contacts, bankAccounts, tags, propertyAccountPayable, propertyAccountReceivable, propertyAccountPosition, propertyPaymentTerm, propertySupplierPaymentTerm, propertyOutboundPaymentMethodLine, propertyInboundPaymentMethodLine | `propertyAccountPayable,propertySupplierPaymentTerm` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by vendor name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[email]` | string | No | Filter by email (partial match) |  |
| `filter[phone]` | string | No | Filter by phone (partial match) |  |
| `filter[parent_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of parent IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of company IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of country IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Available options: with, without, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/vendors?include=propertyAccountPayable%2CpropertySupplierPaymentTerm&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Create vendor

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/vendors`

Create a new vendor

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `account_type` | string | Yes | Account type. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Partner name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `email` | string | No | Email address (max 255 characters). Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `phone` | string | No | Phone number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `mobile` | string | No | Mobile number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `avatar` | string | No | Avatar file path (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `job_title` | string | No | Job title (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `website` | string | No | Website URL (max 255 characters). Must be a valid URL. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `tax_id` | string | No | Tax identification number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_registry` | string | No | Company registry number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `reference` | string | No | Reference code (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `color` | string | No | Color in hex format (max 7 characters). Must not be greater than 7 characters. |
| `street1` | string | No | Street address line 1 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `street2` | string | No | Street address line 2 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `city` | string | No | City (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `zip` | string | No | Postal/ZIP code (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `state_id` | integer | No | State ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `parent_id` | integer | No | Parent partner ID (for addresses and contacts). Must match an existing stored value. |
| `title_id` | integer | No | Title ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `industry_id` | integer | No | Industry ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Associated user ID/Responsible Sale user. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `autopost_bills` | boolean | No | Auto-post bills flag. |
| `ignore_abnormal_invoice_date` | boolean | No | Ignore abnormal invoice date flag. |
| `ignore_abnormal_invoice_amount` | number | No | Ignore abnormal invoice amount threshold. |
| `invoice_sending_method` | string | No | Invoice sending method. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `invoice_edi_format_store` | string | No | Invoice EDI format store. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `peppol_endpoint` | string | No | PEPPOL endpoint. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `peppol_eas` | string | No | PEPPOL EAS. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `comment` | string | No | Additional comments. |
| `property_account_payable_id` | integer | No | Property account payable ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_receivable_id` | integer | No | Property account receivable ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_position_id` | integer | No | Property account position (fiscal position) ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_payment_term_id` | integer | No | Property payment term ID for customers. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_supplier_payment_term_id` | integer | No | Property payment term ID for suppliers. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_outbound_payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | Property outbound payment method line ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_inbound_payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | Property inbound payment method line ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

## Show vendor

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/vendors/{id}`

Retrieve a specific vendor by its ID

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The vendor ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, country, state, title, company, industry, user, creator, addresses, contacts, bankAccounts, tags, propertyAccountPayable, propertyAccountReceivable, propertyAccountPosition, propertyPaymentTerm, propertySupplierPaymentTerm, propertyOutboundPaymentMethodLine, propertyInboundPaymentMethodLine | `propertyAccountPayable,propertySupplierPaymentTerm` |

```bash [cURL]
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Update vendor

<Badge type="tip" text="PUT" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/vendors/{id}`

Update an existing vendor

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The vendor ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `account_type` | string | No | Account type. |
| `name` | string | No | Partner name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `email` | string | No | Email address (max 255 characters). Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `phone` | string | No | Phone number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `mobile` | string | No | Mobile number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `avatar` | string | No | Avatar file path (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `job_title` | string | No | Job title (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `website` | string | No | Website URL (max 255 characters). Must be a valid URL. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `tax_id` | string | No | Tax identification number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_registry` | string | No | Company registry number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `reference` | string | No | Reference code (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `color` | string | No | Color in hex format (max 7 characters). Must not be greater than 7 characters. |
| `street1` | string | No | Street address line 1 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `street2` | string | No | Street address line 2 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `city` | string | No | City (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `zip` | string | No | Postal/ZIP code (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `state_id` | integer | No | State ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `parent_id` | integer | No | Parent partner ID (for addresses and contacts). Must match an existing stored value. |
| `title_id` | integer | No | Title ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `industry_id` | integer | No | Industry ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Associated user ID/Responsible Sale user. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `autopost_bills` | boolean | No | Auto-post bills flag. |
| `ignore_abnormal_invoice_date` | boolean | No | Ignore abnormal invoice date flag. |
| `ignore_abnormal_invoice_amount` | number | No | Ignore abnormal invoice amount threshold. |
| `invoice_sending_method` | string | No | Invoice sending method. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `invoice_edi_format_store` | string | No | Invoice EDI format store. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `peppol_endpoint` | string | No | PEPPOL endpoint. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `peppol_eas` | string | No | PEPPOL EAS. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `comment` | string | No | Additional comments. |
| `property_account_payable_id` | integer | No | Property account payable ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_receivable_id` | integer | No | Property account receivable ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_position_id` | integer | No | Property account position (fiscal position) ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_payment_term_id` | integer | No | Property payment term ID for customers. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_supplier_payment_term_id` | integer | No | Property payment term ID for suppliers. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_outbound_payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | Property outbound payment method line ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_inbound_payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | Property inbound payment method line ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group
